scope: All fixed monitored comparison samples retained, plus two prior current-source stopped preflights. Placement remains scratch; no automatic adoption or external parity claim.

plan.scope: Current-source three-arm Windows comparison under user-directed monitored background activity. Idle time is not required. Prior stopped studies remain separate.
plan.order: Rounds -1..7; workloads rotate by round+1, model order alternates per round, arms rotate by (round+1+model index+workload index)%3 and reverse in odd rounds. A matched block contains all three arms on one model/workload.
plan.contamination: Pre-run activity is recorded, not a launch gate. Run exactly one copy of every scheduled three-arm block, no replacements or activity-based exclusions. Retain old activity thresholds as diagnostic flags, including unavailable/invalid telemetry as unknown. Primary statistics include every completed measured block; report background CPU/disk/GPU and recorder activity per phase/arm alongside timing. Flag potentially affected comparisons and load imbalance; no automatic runtime adoption.
plan.statistics: For all eight paired measured rounds report mean/median TPS and elapsed milliseconds, paired percent differences/range/sample standard deviation and approximate paired Student-t 95% intervals. Also report activity/unknown counts and per-arm background load, check whether differences co-vary with load imbalance; this is association, not causal attribution or a numeric correction. Do not cherry-pick quiet or favorable samples. One-second sample windows are coarse for short followups. Large gains and minor losses are assessed together. No phase or whole-workload number can resolve systematic bias by itself.
plan.assessment: Large gains can justify minor losses. Report primary and follow-up prefill/decode plus combined elapsed workload; do not use isolated 0.5% veto. HF limits unchanged. Current matched mx differences remain explicit; no automatic merge decision in runner.
plan.observer: Identical one-second monitor for all arms; record observer CPU and coverage. No zero-observer-cost claim and no automatic stop for background activity. Report precision limits, especially for sub-percent differences.
plan.commands_and_sources: Frozen manifest hashes source, scripts, binaries, reference DLLs, fixed tokens and both model files before any timed invocation.
limits: Followup1/9 are exact token-prefix reuse workloads, not full interactive template rendering.
8B long-context HF and maximum context are not covered.
Model loading excluded from phase clocks; unavailable processes and short unobserved bursts remain telemetry limitations.
plan.hard_limit_policy: A 600-second harness runtime limit is a prospective abort, not an observation timeout. Terminate only the owned child after this limit or a driver validation error/interruption, wait for terminal exit, preserve logs and stop the study without retrying.

analysis.method: Equal weight per paired round, all eight included; internal run1 only, outer warmup excluded as planned. Phase activity means weight sample CPU by interval overlap, without claiming subsecond resolution. Adjacent counter brackets can overlap: summed weights are not a union of intervals, their fraction can exceed one and they do not measure exact coverage. Approximate paired t intervals are descriptive, unadjusted for multiple comparisons and do not resolve systematic bias. Correlations are associations, not corrections or causal attribution.
